description: Consorzio BIM Teramo Open Data is an external data catalogue linking to multiple resources. This record describes the catalogue inventory, not a single dataset. Saved infrastructure members include Road accident statistics in the Municipalities of the BIM Teramo Consortium in 2023; BIM Teramo school-facility register, academic years 2024–2026. The catalogue publisher identity is not established separately in this link record. The catalogue link comes from saved parent-discovery metadata and its exact seed-to-parent evidence. Coverage here is limited to the individually listed infrastructure resources; the external inventory can also contain other subjects or resource types. Access is through the public catalogue page recorded below. Member formats, licence terms, cost and access requirements vary and must be checked on each source record; no catalogue-wide permission is inferred. The catalogue supports discovery of inputs for infrastructure simulation where individual member metadata establishes that role. Related records are existing members, not an exhaustive inventory. Caveats: no fresh source visit was made for this addition. Current links, historical versions and complete member coverage remain unverified. No dataset files were downloaded.
